title: Yacht Found Drifting, Engine Running, Meal Still Warm — 3 Men Vanished Without a Trace
description:
On April 18, 2007, a fishing crew found the yacht Kaz II drifting off Australia's Great Barrier Reef with the engine still running, sails flapping loose, and a meal left untouched on the table. A laptop still glowed. Three life jackets sat folded and dry. But Derek Batten, and brothers Peter and James Tunstead, were gone — no distress call, no blood, no struggle.

Search crews combed over 15,000 square miles of open water. They found nothing. Not a body, not a shoe, not a wallet. The coroner's 2008 theory was almost too strange to believe: a hat blew off in the wind, one man leaned over the swim platform to grab it, fell in — and the others, trying to save him, went in too. The boat, engine still engaged, sailed on without them.

To this day, not a single body has ever washed ashore. Subscribe now 👇
